name: Карловачки смер 2026
location: Планинарски дом Стражилово, Фрушка гора, Serbia

name: Zapad Fruške Gore 2026
description: The Fruška Gora Marathon is a competitive and recreational sporting event held on Fruška Gora, known for its historic trails and new challenges. The event features various courses, including an ultra-extreme marathon, an ultra marathon, and medium and short courses suited to runners of different abilities. It brings together nature and running enthusiasts, offering a unique experience amid the beautiful landscapes of Fruška Gora. The organizers aim to provide good organization and support for participants throughout the event.
course_highlights: Ultra Extreme Marathon with 5 ITRA points
Middle Eastern Marathon with 3 ITRA points
Apprentice Southern Marathon with 1 ITRA point
additional: Transport to the marathon start from Novi Sad is organized for Saturday from 6:00. On-site registration for the FUN courses is available at Popovica on Saturday. Race packets are collected before the race. The races are scored under the ITRA system across different courses. Participants can expect various race categories, including ultra, medium, and beginner courses, with online registration available. The event is part of a wider festival promoting sport and nature on Fruška Gora.

name: Gučevo winter trail 2026
location: Planinarski dom PK Gučevo, Mount Gučevo, Serbia
description: Gučevo Winter Trail 2026 is a mountain race held on Mount Gučevo, starting near the PK Gučevo Mountain Lodge. The race is challenging, with 700 metres of total elevation gain and 700 metres of descent over a 13 km course. Participants can enjoy the natural scenery and demanding terrain, which tests endurance and running technique. The start is scheduled for 11:00, and the organizers emphasize the importance of following the rules and staying safe during the race.
course_highlights: 13 km course with 700 m of total elevation gain and 700 m of descent
Mountain terrain on Mount Gučevo
Checkpoints at 6 km and at the finish at 13 km
additional: Registration requires confirmation that participants have read and understood the race regulations and risks, as well as permission to use photos and videos from the race. Registration includes consent to participate at one’s own risk and acceptance of the regulations and rules of conduct.

name: Deliblatska Peščara 2026

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Za prijavu je potrebna uplata akontacije u iznosu od 1000 din.

description: Deliblatska Peščara 2026 is a one-day hiking event organized by PSK Pobeda, held in the beautiful surroundings of Deliblatska Peščara near Čardak. Participants can choose between two hiking groups, with routes ranging from 8 to 16 kilometers through rolling landscapes of sand dunes and woodland. The route is easy, with negligible elevation gain, and is suitable for people with light to moderate fitness levels. After the hike, participants can take a break and enjoy an organized lunch with hot soup and refreshments. This event offers a unique opportunity to enjoy nature and spend time together in the spirit of mountaineering.
course_highlights: Routes through rolling landscapes of sand dunes and woodland
Two hiking groups: 15–16 km or 8–10 km
Easy route with negligible elevation gain
additional: Departure is at 7:30 from Nebojšina Street, by the Church of Saint Sava. Recommended gear includes protection from wind, rain, and cold; sturdy hiking boots; layered clothing; a thermos or water bottle (minimum 1 liter); a flashlight; and hiking poles. Advance notice and registration with the guide are required for the organized lunch. Return to Belgrade is planned between 18:30 and 19:00. Participants must bring their hiking membership card, health insurance card, and ID card. The guide assigns bus seats in the order participants register and pay. Hiking through Deliblatska Peščara requires appropriate gear, registration with fee, and participant responsibility.

name: 7. Winter Trail Race na Fruškoj gori
description: The Fruška Gora Marathon is a traditional sports, competitive, and recreational event held on Fruška Gora. The race features a variety of courses, from ultra-extreme to beginner, with challenging climbs and beautiful natural surroundings. Participants can enjoy the challenges and beauty of the mountain terrain while competing in a unique atmosphere. The event brings together runners of all levels and promotes a healthy lifestyle and a love of nature.
course_highlights: Varied courses with 1 to 5 ITRA points
Mountain terrain with significant climbs and descents
Beautiful landscapes and natural surroundings of Fruška Gora
additional: Races are scored under the ITRA system, with different difficulty categories (1 to 5 ITRA points). The event includes ultra-extreme, ultra, medium, short, and beginner marathons. The beginner Southern Marathon is 22 km long, with 898 m of ascent and descent. Group and fun registration options are also available for the shorter courses. The event takes place in April, and the 7th Winter Trail Race on Fruška Gora is held in December. Participation includes courses of various lengths, and the event is part of a series of races on Fruška Gora, focused on trail and mountain sports. Registration details are not available.

name: Avala trail race
description: Avala Trail Race is a mountain race held on Avala near Belgrade. Organized by the "Avala" Mountaineering Club, the event brings together runners who enjoy nature and the challenges of mountain terrain. The race is known for its demanding yet beautiful route through wooded areas, offering an opportunity for both a sporting challenge and camaraderie. The fifth edition of the race is scheduled for March 13, 2027.
course_highlights: Mountain trail on Avala
Wooded areas and natural surroundings
Challenging terrain with climbs
additional: The fifteenth edition of the race is organized by the "Avala" Mountaineering Club from Belgrade. Around 70 participants have registered for 2027 so far. Photographer Nemanja Jovanović is covering the event. Participants can expect medals, T-shirts, and professional timing. The race is part of an annual tradition of events on Avala.

name: Kablar Skyrace 2026
description: Kablar Skyrace is a mountain race held on the slopes of Kablar in the spectacular Ovčar-Kablar Gorge. The race is 22.4 km long, with 1,600 metres of cumulative elevation gain, and is worth 1 ITRA point. The course combines fast sections through forests, technically challenging rocky segments, and climbs to two peaks of Kablar, offering beautiful views of the West Morava and surrounding mountains. The race is intended both for beginners in mountain running and experienced runners who want to enjoy the nature of western Serbia. It is organized by the "Kablar" Mountaineering Society of Čačak under the auspices of the Mountaineering Association of Serbia.
course_highlights: 22.4 km with 1,600 m of cumulative elevation gain
Technically challenging rocky sections and two Kablar peaks (889 and 885 m)
Views of the West Morava, Ovčar, Jelica, and Debela Gora
additional: The race has a four-hour time limit for competitors in the PSS National Series. The course is certified and is worth 1 ITRA point. The start and finish are at the Nature Center in Ovčar Banja. The organizer provides good race management, clear course markings, and safety throughout the race. The 2026 edition started and finished at the Nature Center in Ovčar Banja; it is listed as certified for 1 ITRA point. That page lists the date as April 4, 2026, not April 10, 2027.

name: Fruškogorski maraton
distance_verbose: 134 km, 100 km, 59 km, Maraton, Polumaraton, 10 km
description: The Fruška Gora Marathon is a sporting competition and recreational event with a long tradition. It takes place in the hilly, forested area of Fruška Gora, near Novi Sad. The routes pass through natural beauty spots and numerous medieval Serbian monasteries, as well as historical and cultural landmarks. The competitive courses are ITRA-certified and serve as qualifiers for the Ultra-Trail du Mont-Blanc. In addition to the competitive courses, there are nine recreational routes that promote a healthy lifestyle and nature conservation.
course_highlights: The routes pass through 97% forested terrain on Fruška Gora
Pass through medieval Serbian monasteries such as Grgeteg, Staro Hopovo, Novo Hopovo, Jazak, and Bešenovo
Climb Fruška Gora’s highest peak (539 m) and descend past the Dombovački Stream waterfall
additional: The competitive courses are ITRA-certified and serve as qualifiers for the Ultra-Trail du Mont-Blanc. There are 14 different routes of varying distances and elevation gains, ranging from an ultra-extreme 134 km marathon to recreational routes. The routes include natural and cultural landmarks, as well as historical sites. The organizer also has a Viber group for registrations and communication. 14 routes of varying distances, ITRA-certified, including ultra and recreational distances, passing medieval monasteries and natural and cultural landmarks.

name: 49th Fruška Gora Trail
location: Planinarski dom Železničar, Fruška Gora, Serbia

tiers.description: Applications for Ultra Extreme, Ultra, Middle East, Small East Extreme and Trainee South Trails are done exclusively via online applications until 15th of April, 2026.

description: Fruška Gora Trail is a traditional sporting competition held on Fruška Gora, known for its old trails and new challenges. The race features a range of courses and categories, from ultra-extreme to recreational, suited to runners of different levels. The event brings together nature and running enthusiasts, offering a unique experience amid beautiful landscapes and demanding terrain. The organizers strive to provide quality logistics, including organized transport to the start and extensive support during the race.
course_highlights: Varied courses with ITRA points from 1 to 5
Courses ranging from mini to ultra-extreme marathons
Beautiful natural landscapes of Fruška Gora, with challenging climbs and descents
additional: Organized transport from Novi Sad to the race start on April 25, 2026, from 6 a.m. Registration for individual sport categories and groups is open until April 15, 2026. The race includes courses with different ITRA point values, from 1 to 5, and distances suited to runners of all levels. The event features multiple race categories, online registration, organized transport from Novi Sad, and a variety of courses for runners of all levels.

name: Šumadija Trejl Staza Snage (Gledićke Planine)
description: Šumadija Trail Strength Course is a challenging race through the unspoiled nature of the Gledić Mountains, with two courses that test runners’ strength and endurance. The longer course, Prkos, is 17.5 km long with 1,000 meters of elevation gain, while the shorter course, Zamah, is 8 km long with 450 meters of elevation gain. The race combines steep climbs and technical descents, offering a unique challenge and an opportunity to enjoy Šumadija hospitality. The start and finish are at Adžine Livade, and runners receive a generous race pack and a surprise lunch.

name: 4. Jablanik Trail
description: Jablanik Trail is a UTMB Index race held in Valjevo, Serbia. The race is 34 kilometers long with a total elevation gain of 1,837 meters, offering runners challenging and attractive terrain. The course provides a unique opportunity to experience the natural beauty of western Serbia through its mountainous landscapes. The race brings together experienced runners and trail-running enthusiasts, creating a competitive and friendly atmosphere.

name: Takovski grm
description: Takovski Grm is a 13.5 km road race taking place on April 26, 2026, starting in Takovo and finishing in Gornji Milanovac. The race runs through Takovo’s historic natural surroundings along a newly opened route, with plenty of uphill and downhill sections, offering a challenge and the enjoyment of natural beauty. The organizers invite runners to join them for a shared running experience, race results, and a gathering at the finish. All participants who complete the race receive a finisher’s medal, while the top runners are awarded cash prizes and trophies.

name: Iron Ultra Trail
description: Iron Ultra Trail is a challenging trail race held in Valjevo, known for its demanding routes and beautiful landscapes of Western Serbia. The race brings together trail-running enthusiasts and adventurers, offering a unique experience through forest and mountain terrain. The organizers, West Serbia Trails, guarantee a great atmosphere and good organization for all participants.

name: Fox Trail Čardak 2026
description: Fox Trail Čardak is a race through the unique landscape of the Deliblato Sands, giving participants the opportunity to choose from three distances: a recreational 5 km, a challenging 12 km, and a 21 km trail half marathon. The event takes place on May 9, 2026, in Čardak and is intended for all nature and running enthusiasts, whether beginners or experienced runners. The course is carefully designed to offer an authentic running experience in nature, with challenges and the natural beauty of the sands.

name: Urbani polumaraton
description: The Urbana Desetka Sports Association invites you to take part in the Urbana Half Marathon in Smederevo on May 10, 2026. The event features the second year of the 21 km half marathon and the third year of the 10 km Danube Ten, races that run along the banks of the Danube, through the city center, past the Obrenović Villa and through the Jugovo neighborhood. Runners will enjoy a combination of flat terrain and rolling vineyards, with the start at Republic Square in front of the courthouse. Each participant receives a chip-timed bib, a unique T-shirt and a medal, as well as refreshments during and after the race.

name: First Challenge Run
description: First Challenge Run is a charity race taking place on May 10, 2026, at Ada Ciganlija in Belgrade. Runners will complete a 7.7 km loop around the lake, enjoying nature and a sporting challenge. The race is an opportunity to gather, socialize, and support a charitable cause, and is suitable for both experienced runners and beginners.

name: Ugrin run
description: Ugrin Run is a race taking place in Ugrinovci on May 10, 2026, starting at 10:00. The race offers two distances, 5 km and 10 km, on a highly accessible, safe, and clearly marked course, with two water and fruit aid stations. In addition to the main races, fun children’s races are organized for different age groups. These are free with parental consent. Participants receive a unique medal at the finish, and merchandise prizes and trophies are provided for the top finishers.

name: Kozomor 2026
description: The Kozomor Hiking and Running Association and the PSS Hiking Trekking Commission invite competitors to the second round of the Serbian Trekking and Trail League, which will take place on May 10, 2026, in Kosjerić. This race brings together enthusiasts of mountain trekking and trail running, offering a challenging and scenic route through nature. Participants can expect a well-organized event supported by experienced hiking and running enthusiasts.

name: Nebeski visovi – 4. kolo Nacionalne serije u planinskom trčanju
description: The Nebeski Visovi race in Zlatibor is the fourth round of the National Mountain Running Series, organized by the Tornik Mountaineering Club from Čajetina. Participants can choose between two loop courses: a longer 21 km red course with 1,400 meters of elevation gain for seniors, and a shorter 10 km blue course with 500 meters of elevation gain for juniors. The routes pass through Zlatibor’s unspoiled nature and over the peaks of Ljujaš, Orlić, Jelova Gora, Bandera-Tornik, and Liska, offering scenic, wild landscapes. The race brings together competitors from across Serbia and abroad. Scoring in the National Series follows the rules of the Mountaineering Association of Serbia, a member of the World Mountain Running Association.

name: Somborski polumaraton
description: The Sombor Half Marathon is a traditional race held in Sombor, with a new course passing through beautiful parts of the city. The event brings together a large number of runners from Serbia and abroad, promoting a healthy lifestyle and recreational running. The organizers strive to make the race well organized and enjoyable for all participants, with particular attention to the atmosphere and socializing. The race is part of the rich program of activities of the Somaraton Athletics and Recreation Club, which has nurtured Sombor’s long-standing running tradition.

name: 1. Tibužde Trail
description: 1. Tibužde Trail is a trail race held in Tibužde, Vranje. Runners can choose between two course distances, 27 km and 7 km, offering challenging terrain and beautiful scenery. The event starts in the morning and lasts all day, giving participants a unique trail-running experience.
course_highlights: A 27 km course with 3,000 metres of elevation gain
A shorter 7 km course with 3,000 metres of elevation gain
Natural terrain around Tibužde
additional: The event runs from 7 a.m. to 5 p.m. Terrain: mountainous; registration open; several categories, including a children’s race; shared lunch after the race.

name: Dragutin Tomašević
description: The Dragutin Tomašević Memorial Athletics Race is held in the village of Bistrica near Petrovac na Mlavi in memory of the first Serbian Olympian. This anniversary 21st race brings together runners of all ages and categories, offering opportunities to compete in men’s and women’s divisions as well as by age group. Participants receive chip-timed race bibs and “Joma” Dry Fit shirts, while the organizer provides transportation and a formal dinner. The race is known for its tradition and support from the local community, creating a welcoming atmosphere for all runners.

name: Ivanjica Trail
description: Ivanjica Trail is a unique trail race in Serbia, bringing together runners of different fitness levels across several courses of varying lengths and difficulty. The races take place in the beautiful natural surroundings of Ivanjica and Golija, with viewpoints, meadows, forests, and streams, offering an unforgettable running experience in nature. Special highlights include the Golija PREMIUM race, which starts at the summit of Golija, and the ULTRA 66K, a two-day stage race connecting three mountains and offering a challenge for experienced runners. The organizers provide race packs, refreshments, lunch, transport, and accommodation for participants, creating a friendly and supportive atmosphere.

name: ONERUN 2026
description: One Run is an international race taking place for the eighth consecutive year, simultaneously across multiple countries and continents. The event is known for being entered into the Guinness World Records twice as the world’s largest half marathon with a synchronized start. The race is open to everyone, with four distances available, and promotes health, accessibility, and togetherness through sport and outdoor activities. This year, we’re running in Veliko Gradište, Serbia, on May 23, aiming to become part of a new attempt at a Guinness World Record for the first time in Serbia.

name: Trail trka Tibuzde 2026
location: село Тибужде, 5 км од града Врање
description: 1. Tibužde Trail is a trail race held in the village of Tibužde, near Vranje. The race offers two different distances, 27 km and 7 km, giving participants the opportunity to enjoy challenging terrain and the beauty of nature. The race starts at 7 a.m., and the event runs until 5 p.m., creating a great atmosphere for all running and nature enthusiasts.

name: Mokra Gora Trail
description: Mokra Gora Trail is a new regional hiking trail that runs across Mount Mokra Gora, connecting Montenegro, Kosovo* and Serbia. The trail is part of the Via Dinarica network and offers a unique opportunity for adventure tourism and exploration of the Balkans’ unspoiled nature. It was developed with the support of the Institute for Territorial Economic Development and the Regional Cooperation Council, with the aim of promoting cross-border tourism and preserving the region’s natural beauty. The trail is known for its Via Ferrata attractions, which offer exciting experiences for hikers and nature lovers.
course_highlights: The trail runs across Mount Mokra Gora, connecting three countries: Montenegro, Kosovo* and Serbia
It is part of the Via Dinarica network, known for its unspoiled nature and mountain landscapes
Via Ferrata sections offer adventure opportunities for hikers
additional: The trail is part of the Via Dinarica cross-border project and was developed to promote sustainable tourism and improve infrastructure. No race price or registration details are listed, indicating that the focus is on the hiking trail rather than a competition. The contact organization is the Regional Cooperation Council, headquartered in Sarajevo. The project is linked to the development of regional hiking trails, including Via Ferrata, GPS mapping and the installation of signage, with the aim of promoting sustainable tourism and cooperation in the region.

name: Tour de Fruška
distance_verbose: 59 km, 39 km, Polumaraton, 15 km, 7 km, 2 km, 1 km
description: Tour de Fruška is one of the region’s most attractive sporting events, held in the beautiful surroundings of Fruška Gora, in Vrdnik. The event brings together sport, nature, and tourism, offering participants a unique experience of cycling through unspoiled nature and beautiful landscapes. It gathers cycling and active holiday enthusiasts, promoting a healthy lifestyle and the tourism potential of Vojvodina.

name: Ozren i Devica 2026
description: The Devica–Ozren hiking trip, organized by PSK Pobeda, takes participants on a climb up Mount Devica, one of the most beautiful and northernmost mountains in the Balkans. The route passes through lush vegetation and limestone formations dotted with numerous caves, including a climb to Soko Grad and the Golem Kamen viewpoint, and finishes along a forest trail toward Ozren and Ripaljka Waterfall. The trip lasts one day, departing from Belgrade in the early morning and returning in the evening. Participants must have a Planinarski savez Srbije membership booklet valid for 2026 and suitable hiking equipment.

name: Serbia EPIC MIONICA #3
description: Serbia EPIC MIONICA #3 is an exciting series of races held in Mionica, offering a range of distances for runners of different levels. The races include mountain and cycling marathons, as well as shorter courses, all set in the beautiful natural surroundings of Stara Planina. This event attracts nature and sports enthusiasts, offering challenging and scenic routes. You are welcome to take part and enjoy the unique atmosphere and sporting spirit.
course_highlights: A variety of courses from 7 km to 60 km
Mountain and cycling marathons on Stara Planina
Beautiful natural landscapes and challenging terrain

name: Stazama Vuka Karadžića
description: The Vuk Karadžić Trails is a 25 km loop race with a total elevation gain of 1,000 metres. The course starts at Vuk’s memorial house and runs through the shade of the centuries-old Monastery Forests, past woodland streams and waterfalls to the 13th-century Tronoša Monastery. It then continues across Mala Tronoša and Lisina to Zajača, from where the Monastery Candles Trail leads to Velika Bobija and the Miličin Konak ethno complex, before returning to Tršić and Vuk’s house, where the finish is located. This race offers a unique opportunity to enjoy the region’s natural beauty and cultural and historical landmarks.

name: Kros Trka Carica
description: The Carica Cross-Country Race is a traditional outdoor race held in Mali Stapar, bringing together runners of all ages, from children to competitors over seventy. The main race is 6.4 km long, preceded by children’s races with around forty participants. The event celebrates the traditions of sport, friendship, and spending time outdoors, and the organizers invite everyone to take part and enjoy this sporting event. The race is a prelude to the Friendship Race held in Kula, continuing the tradition of sport and community.

name: Humanitarna IT trka „Štafeta srcem”
description: The charity IT race “Štafeta srcem” will take place on June 5, 2026, at Niš Fortress. This event brings together the IT community and running enthusiasts in a charitable atmosphere, promoting solidarity and support through sport. The race is an opportunity to socialize, stay active, and contribute to the community in the beautiful surroundings of the fortress.

name: Dušan Milošević Memorial Trail
description: The Dušan Milošević Memorial Trail is a race held in honor of Serbia’s first Olympian, Dušan Milošević, and takes runners along the most beautiful trails of Rudnik. The race is dedicated to his courage and perseverance, and aims to honor his legacy and the Serbian spirit through running. Three courses are available: the fast, shorter Vihor course; the more challenging Rudnik course, with steep climbs and descents; and the non-competitive Domaćinska course for those who want to enjoy nature. The race is an opportunity to celebrate history, courage, and community.

name: Kup Fruške Gore 2026
description: The Fruška Gora Cup 2026 is a traditional sports, competition and recreation event held on Fruška Gora. The races cover a range of trails, including the ultra-extreme marathon, ultra marathon, middle eastern marathon and beginner trails, with varying levels of difficulty and distance. The event brings together runners from Serbia and abroad, offering challenges on Fruška Gora’s old trails and a chance to enjoy nature and the spirit of sport. The organizers also provide transportation to the start and extensive support throughout the event.

name: Serbia EPIC VRNJAČKA BANJA #4
description: The UCI XCO race in Andrevlje is an exciting competition that brings together elite and junior riders in the men's and women's categories. Held in front of the Ceptor Hotel amid the beautiful surroundings of Andrevlje, it lasts four days and offers an outstanding atmosphere and intense competition. Riders can expect electronic timing, fully marked trails, and a comprehensive race pack with a T-shirt, medal, and refreshments on the course. This is an event that combines a passion for sport with the natural beauty of Serbia.

name: Village Trail
description: Village Trail 2026 is the third edition of the race, held in Višnjica, on the outskirts of Belgrade, on June 7, 2026. The race combines sport, nature, and adventure, with two courses winding through beautiful scenery, including a viewpoint overlooking the Danube and Belgrade. The start and finish are at Dunavska terasa restaurant, and the event is suitable for experienced runners and beginners. An entertainment program is provided for children and families, while runners can look forward to support from volunteers and an after-run party.

name: Stara Planina 2026
description: Stara Planina Skiing 2026 is a four-day winter program offering skiing, sledding, walks, and socializing amid the unspoiled nature of Stara Planina. Enjoy the thrills and beautiful scenery at the Babin Zub ski resort, with over 13 kilometers of groomed runs of varying difficulty, including a freeride run and an artificial snowmaking system. The program is for skiers and winter sports enthusiasts, with departures from Belgrade and Niš and accommodation at Ždrma Inn. If there is not enough snow, hiking tours are organized, making the event accessible to nature lovers and those seeking an active holiday.

name: Sunrise Marathon
description: The Sunrise Marathon in Bačka Palanka supports the mission of the Sunrise Association, an organization that provides free summer day camps for children with cancer and their siblings. Runners are invited to join Team Sunrise and help bring joy and happiness back to children battling this disease through running and fundraising. By taking part in the race, participants have the opportunity to support unique programs and camps that bring smiles and hope to children around the world.

name: Vidra Gradac Trail
description: Vidra Gradac Trail offers a unique running experience along the Gradac River, known for its unspoiled nature and crystal-clear water. The course winds through a canyon rich in wildlife and varied terrain, including forest trails, rocky riverbanks, and stream crossings. This race combines natural beauty and adventure, making it ideal for runners who want to experience trail running at its most scenic. It takes place in Valjevo, Serbia, and is part of the West Serbia Trails series, which connects the mountains, rivers, and valleys of western Serbia.

name: Ultramaraton Palić
description: The Palić Ultramarathon is a national and international ultramarathon championship held in Palić and organized by the Ultramarathon Association of Serbia. The race includes several disciplines: 6-, 12- and 24-hour races, as well as 50 km and 100 km races, starting and finishing at the Great Terrace. The competition is open to all ultramarathon runners who follow the rules, with participants competing in the overall and age categories. Alongside the competitive spirit, the race offers a well-stocked aid station, a communal lunch and prizes for the top finishers, as well as special prizes for the youngest and oldest participants.

name: Trka prijateljstva Kula
description: The Friendship Race in Kula is a traditional event held since 2009 that promotes sport, friendship, family values, and recreation. The race brings together amateur, recreational, and professional runners from the region and beyond, creating a unique running community. Over the years, it has become the largest sporting event in the municipality of Kula, with more than 6,000 participants and a total of 34,000 kilometers run. The organizers continually improve the event, prizes, and organization to make the race even better and more appealing to all participants.

name: ISKRA Trail Kosmaj
description: Iskra Kosmaj Trail is a trail race held on the beautiful Mount Kosmaj, giving participants the chance to enjoy dense forests and stunning views. The race is a great opportunity for a day out and socializing in the race village, located in the start and finish area. Three distances are available, and the race is open to runners, walkers, and Nordic walkers of all ages, with parental consent required for participants under 18. The organizer guarantees safety and a great atmosphere, and participants receive a race pack with a T-shirt if they register on time.

name: Noćni maraton
organizer: Tletsko rekreativni klub “Fruška gora” – Novi Sad
description: The Novi Sad Night Marathon is one of the most popular races in Serbia and a unique nighttime athletics and recreational event. The main race is a 42 km marathon that requires dedication and mental strength, while the half marathon attracts the most participants and brings a special nighttime race atmosphere. There is also a mini marathon for children and Nordic walking, making the event accessible to all ages and fitness levels. The race has become a tradition and a source of pride for Novi Sad, with carefully organized race packages and a rich program on the course and after the race.

name: Mala Sveta Gora
description: The Mala Sveta Gora running race takes place in the beautiful setting of Ovčar Banja and offers three running categories: 5 km, 10 km, and a half marathon (21 km). The race is known for its challenging course through nature, offering runners a unique experience and the chance to compete over different distances. The organizers invite all running enthusiasts to take advantage of promotional prices and take part in this sporting event, which brings together runners from across the region.

name: TORNIK RACE 2026
description: Tornik Race is a unique running adventure on Zlatibor that combines adrenaline-fueled challenges with nature conservation. The races are suited to all ages and ability levels, with 6 km, 15 km and 25 km courses, as well as children’s races. Participants can enjoy the natural beauty of Tornik, test their endurance and contribute to environmental protection through the Plogging Race. The organizers aim to build a community of passionate runners and nature lovers, offering an unforgettable experience and a healthy sporting spirit.

name: OK Trip Trail
description: OK Trip Trail is a race held in the beautiful setting of Ovčar Banja, known for its natural beauty and healthy lifestyle. The race brings together sports and nature enthusiasts, offering a unique opportunity to enjoy a challenging course through forested areas and mountain terrain. The Festival of a Healthy Spirit, under whose auspices the race is organized, promotes an active and healthy lifestyle in the heart of Serbia.

name: Tara Ultra Trail 2026
organizer: Udruženje Tara Ultra i PK Tara
description: Tara Ultra Trail 2026 is a mountain trail race held in Tara National Park, Bajina Bašta, on the first weekend of July. The race offers several distances suited to different fitness levels, from a vertical climb to an ultra-long 62 km course with significant elevation gain. The routes pass through hidden and scenic parts of Tara, giving runners an unforgettable experience of nature and a challenge for body and mind. In addition to the races, an all-day outdoor festival and accompanying cultural events take place at the finish, creating a unique atmosphere for participants and visitors alike.

name: Balkan Mountain and Trail Running Championships
organizer: Balkan Mountaineering Union (BMU), Planinarski savez Srbije (PSS), Tara Ultra Trail, Planinarski klub Tara
description: The first Balkan Mountain and Trail Running Championships will be held from July 2 to 4, 2026, in Tara National Park and Bajina Bašta, Serbia. The competition includes four races: Mountain Uphill, Mountain Classic, Mountain Trail, and U18 Mountain Classic, bringing together the best mountain runners in the Balkans. The courses are varied and challenging, with spectacular scenery and technical climbs, offering a true test and an enjoyable experience in nature. The organizers are the Balkan Mountaineering Union, the Mountaineering Association of Serbia, Tara Ultra Trail, and Tara Mountaineering Club. We invite all runners to join us and celebrate mountain and trail running in the heart of Serbia.

name: Treska Trail
description: Join an adventurous hiking tour with Kežman Mountain Houses to the summit of Treska on Kopaonik. This short 650-meter trail leads to an impressive peak at 1,622 meters above sea level, offering beautiful panoramic views of the surrounding mountains and valleys. The trail is well marked and suitable for all guests. The ascent takes about 30 minutes, giving you the chance to enjoy nature and take photos. Organized tours are available to all accommodation guests, with transportation to the trailhead.

name: 48. Trka oko Avale
distance_verbose: 5 km, 3000 metara, 2 km, 1 km, 0.5 km, 0.3 km, 0.2 km
description: The Race Around Avala is a traditional event organized by the Serbian Masters Athletics Association. The race takes place in the beautiful surroundings of Avala and brings together runners of different ages and fitness levels. It is an opportunity for sporting camaraderie and for promoting athletics among masters and recreational runners. The start and finish are at an attractive location, and the course offers both challenges and enjoyment of nature.

name: Jadovnički Ultramaraton 2026
description: The Jadovnik Ultramarathon 2026 is a unique trail event in western Serbia, bringing together lovers of nature, endurance, and extreme races. It takes place on July 10 and 11 in Prijepolje, with the start and finish at the Cultural Center Plaza. All the courses are new and do not repeat those from the previous edition, and the races are suited to different fitness levels and runner categories. Participants receive a race pack with a T-shirt, promotional materials, and a finisher’s medal, while the organizers also provide support with accommodation and meals.

name: Jadovnički ultramaraton
description: The Jadovnik Ultramarathon was first organized by the Jadovnik Citizens’ Association on the mountain of the same name. The race aims to showcase the beauty and rich flora and fauna of Mount Jadovnik, which has so far been little known to the public. This ultramarathon offers runners a unique opportunity to experience the challenge and special appeal of running in unspoiled nature. The organizers aim to preserve and promote the mountain through sport and community.

name: Cer Night trail
description: Cer Night Trail is a night race held on Mount Cer, known for its beautiful natural scenery and challenging trails. The race brings together trail-running enthusiasts who enjoy running through forests and mountain terrain beneath the starry sky. The event is part of the Cer Trail race series, which promotes community, perseverance, and a love of nature. Cer Night Trail gives runners the opportunity to experience the magic of night trail running in the unique setting of Mount Cer.
course_highlights: A night race through the forests and mountain terrain of Mount Cer
Challenging trails with natural obstacles and beautiful views
A sense of community and support among runners
additional: Cer Night Trail is part of the Cer Trail race series, which also includes Cer Winter Trail and Cer Ultra Trail. The race is a member of the UTMB and ITRA communities. The Instagram profile promotes the values of community, support, and runners’ strength, especially that of women. Photos and videos from previous races are available on the Instagram profile.

name: Night Challenge Fruška Gora 2026
location: Restoran Na Vencu, Fruška Gora, Serbia
description: The Night Challenge on Fruška Gora is a sports and recreational event for hikers, runners, and nature lovers. It takes place on three courses of varying lengths: Fan Hiking (7 km), Hobby Trail (11 km), and Sport Trail (19 km). The start is at 21:00 by the Na Vencu restaurant, and participants have a time limit of 4 hours and 15 minutes to complete the course, allowing even the slowest participants to finish successfully. The event offers a unique opportunity to enjoy the nature of Fruška Gora at night.

name: 6. NIGHT CHALLENGE FRUŠKA GORA 2026
location: Spomenik Sloboda, Iriški venac, Fruška Gora, Serbia
description: The 6th Night Challenge Fruška Gora 2026 is a night OCR race held in the unspoiled nature of Fruška Gora, starting at the Monument to Freedom, Iriški Venac. Competitors can choose between two courses, 7 km and 13 km, which wind through dense forest and natural obstacles, including unique water obstacles at Ledinačko Lake. The race combines adrenaline-pumping obstacles with beautiful scenery and concludes in a spirit of camaraderie and celebration at the end of the season. The event is part of the Invictus OCR League and is intended for everyone who wants to test their limits and enjoy sport and nature.

name: 44. Kanjiža Running & Swimming Festival
distance_verbose: 13 km, 10 km, 5 km, 3000 metara, 2.6 km, 1.4 km, 0.9 km, 0.57 km, 0.2 km

name: Tara Extreme Skymarathon – 5. kolo Nacionalne serije u planinskom trčanju
description: Tara Extreme Skymarathon is a challenging mountain running race held on the beautiful and demanding trails of Tara National Park. The race is part of the National Mountain Running Series and brings together competitors who want to test their physical and mental limits on demanding terrain with significant elevation gain. The start and finish are in Mitrovac, the traditional location for this event. During the race, participants can enjoy spectacular views and Tara’s wild natural scenery.
course_highlights: Trails with significant elevation gain of up to 3150 meters
The beautiful, wild nature of Tara National Park
Three different courses: SkyTrail (10 km), SkyRace (24 km), SkyMarathon (44 km)
additional: The race takes place in Mitrovac, with the start and finish at the same location. There are three courses with different distances and elevation gains: SkyTrail (10 km, 700D+), SkyRace (24 km, 1700D+), SkyMarathon (44 km, 3150D+). The race is known for its difficulty and for testing competitors’ limits. The organizers thank the competitors, volunteers, and sponsors for their support.

name: Tara Extreme Skychallange
organizer: Udruženje Tara Ultra i PK Tara
description: Tara Extreme SkyChallenge is a unique skyrunning race held in the heart of Tara National Park, starting and finishing at the Mountain Lodge in Rastište. The race features three different courses that are technically demanding and physically challenging, intended for experienced mountain runners. Sports and recreational activities for all ages are also organized as part of the event, making it appealing to a wider audience. The courses are certified according to ISF, ITRA and UTMB standards, and the race is part of the PSS National Mountain Running Series.

name: Iskra Avala Night Trail
description: Iskra Avala Night Trail is a night trail race held on 29 August 2026 on Mount Avala. The race starts at 20:30 in front of the Avala Tower, and runners will enjoy the special atmosphere of a nighttime adventure, with headlamps required. In addition to the race, a race village with food, drinks and music will be set up in the start and finish area. The race is open to runners, walkers and Nordic walkers, with prizes for the top men and women in both distances.

name: Dunavske Čarolije 2026
description: Dunavske Čarolije is a unique event in Čortanovci combining running, cycling, orienteering, water jumping, hiking, films, music, and volleyball. This festival of sport and entertainment brings together participants of all ages and offers a variety of activities on the banks of the Danube. The atmosphere is friendly and family-oriented, with a rich program running throughout the day. Everyone is invited to join and enjoy the charms of the Danube and the sporting challenges.

name: Avala noćna trail 2026
description: Iskra Avala Night Trail is a night trail race taking place on August 29, 2026, on the plateau in front of the Avala Tower in Belgrade. The race starts at 8:30 p.m. and offers a unique night-time experience on Mount Avala, with a race village providing entertainment before, during, and after the race. Participants can choose between two distances, 6 km and 10 km, and a headlamp is mandatory. The race is open to runners, walkers, and Nordic walkers, with prizes for the top men and women in both distances.

name: Vlasina 2026
description: The Vlasina Triathlon of Self-Transcendence is a traditional race held at the beautiful Vlasina Lake near Vladičin Han. Participants can choose from the Olympic, Sprint, Super Sprint, Super Kid, and Mini Kid triathlons, tailored to different ages and competition levels. The race is known for its atmosphere of self-transcendence and the support provided by the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team, which promotes sport and spirituality. Each competitor receives a race number, a certificate, and a finisher’s medal.

name: Bukovački maraton 2026
description: The Bukovac Marathon – Long Course is a challenging mountain race held on Fruška Gora, starting and finishing in Bukovac. The course is 47.8 km long, with 1,350 metres of ascent and 1,350 metres of descent. It is well maintained and marked with red-and-white hiking blazes, and passes significant sites including the Novo Hopovo, Staro Hopovo, Grgeteg, Krušedol and Velika Remeta monasteries, as well as Branko’s Grave and monument. The race is intended for experienced hikers and runners who want to experience the natural surroundings and cultural heritage of Fruška Gora.

name: Radmilovac Trail
description: Radmilovac Trail is a unique race held in the green natural oasis of Radmilovac, not far from Belgrade. The race takes runners through orchards, vineyards, and fishponds, offering beautiful natural scenery and a pleasant atmosphere. In addition to the standard 5 km and 10 km races, there is a special academic category for PhDs and doctoral candidates, aimed at promoting a healthy lifestyle. The event is organized by the Faculty of Agriculture in Zemun and AGRIF runners, and is known for its generous race pack and prizes for the top competitors.

name: Soko Čovka trail
description: Soko Čovka Trail is a mountain race held in Lazarevac, Županjac. It is organized by the VIS Mountaineering Club and gives participants the opportunity to enjoy the natural beauty of central Serbia on challenging trails. The race brings together nature and sports enthusiasts, offering a unique atmosphere and a well-organized event.
course_highlights: The race takes place in the natural surroundings of Lazarevac and Županjac
Mountain terrain with challenging climbs and descents
Views of central Serbia and the surrounding landscapes

name: 10. Zrenjaninski polumaraton
description: The Zrenjanin Half Marathon is a traditional race held in Zrenjanin since 2016 and is known as one of the best-organized half marathons in Serbia. The course is 21.1 km long, flat and circular, and passes through the city’s most beautiful areas, including the 4. jul and Ruža Šulman neighborhoods, with the start in front of City Hall. In addition to the half marathon, the event offers 7 km and 14 km races, Nordic walking, and a 3 x 7 km relay, welcoming runners of different abilities and ages. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle and a sense of community, and runners become part of the story of a city known for its big heart and generous hosts.

name: Župska vinska trka 2026
description: The Župa Wine Run is a unique sporting and wine event held in the beautiful landscape of Župa, a renowned wine region in central Serbia. The race brings together wine and sports enthusiasts on a course that passes vineyards, mountains, and cultural and historical landmarks such as the medieval town of Koznik. Participants enjoy tastings at aid stations and receive an official T-shirt, a finisher’s medal, and other souvenirs. The event promotes the region’s rich traditions and natural beauty. The race starts at 12:00, and race packs can be collected until 11:00.

name: Rajac 2026
description: Kosidba on Rajac is a traditional event held since 1892, on the first Sunday after Petrovdan. It brings together mowers dressed in traditional peasant costumes, who compete in hand-mowing grass on prepared plots. In addition to the competition, the program includes an exhibition of mowing tools, folk performances, and cultural and artistic activities, creating a unique atmosphere and preserving folk traditions.

name: Petrovaradin Fortress NIGHT trail Serbia EPIC 2026
location: Petrovaradin Fortress, Petrovaradin, Novi Sad, Serbia

name: Jesenji planinarski maraton na Fruškoj gori
description: The Autumn Mountain Marathon on Fruška Gora is a traditional sports and recreation event that brings runners together on challenging trails through the beautiful nature of Fruška Gora. The races cover various distances, from ultra-extreme to beginner trails, and are suited to different fitness levels. The event takes place in Popovica near Sremska Kamenica and offers a unique combination of challenge and enjoyment of nature. The organizers also provide transport to the start, as well as extensive support during the race.

name: Povlen Trail
description: Povlen Trail is part of the West Serbia Trails series, which connects the mountains, rivers, and valleys of western Serbia through unique trail races. This race gives runners the opportunity to explore unspoiled nature and enjoy the challenges of mountain trails. West Serbia Trails promotes a blend of sport, nature, and community, creating an unforgettable experience for all participants.

name: Kamenica trejl 2026
description: Kamenica Trail 2026 is the first race in the South Trail Series, taking place on October 18, 2026, at the Dabilo recreation area near Niš. The race offers two courses: a long course of 20.7 km with 810 meters of elevation gain and a short course of 5.6 km with 240 meters of elevation gain. Both start and finish at the same location. The routes follow forest trails, gravel roads, and a stretch of asphalt, offering a challenge and beautiful scenery. The event is organized by the Running and Mountaineering Association “Running club Niš.” Participants can expect good organization, refreshments, and prizes.

name: Viking Challenge Trail
location: Fruška Gora - Planinarski dom Jedinstvo, Fruška Gora, Serbia
description: Viking Challenge is a race held on Fruška Gora, with courses of varying distances suited to all ages and running abilities. Participants can choose courses from 1 km to 22 km, enjoying well-marked terrain and support from volunteers. The race offers electronic timing, medals, promotional T-shirts, as well as refreshments and a meal after the race. The atmosphere is friendly and motivating, with an emphasis on community and sporting spirit.
course_highlights: Courses of 1 km, 5.5 km, 11 km, and 22 km on Fruška Gora
Well-marked courses with support from volunteers and spectators
Electronic timing and GPX files available for navigation
additional: Starts are assigned in groups according to registration dates, with no option to change groups. Participants receive a medal, promotional T-shirt, race photos, water, juice, and energy drinks, as well as a meal after the race. Medical assistance is available in case of injury. Trail race, electronic timing, GPX route files available, post-race gathering

name: Ovčar 2026
description: Kablar Skyrace is a mountain race held in the spectacular Ovčar-Kablar Gorge, starting and finishing in Ovčar Banja. The 22.4 km race, with 1,600 metres of cumulative elevation gain, runs through forested terrain, technically challenging rocky sections and over two Kablar peaks, offering runners a challenge and beautiful panoramic views of the West Morava River and the surrounding mountains. The race is part of the Mountaineering Association of Serbia’s national series and is intended for both experienced runners and recreational runners who want to enjoy nature and test their abilities. It is organised by the “Kablar” Mountaineering Club of Čačak, which is celebrating its 75th anniversary this year and guarantees good organisation and safety during the race.
course_highlights: 22.4 km long with 1,600 m of cumulative elevation gain
Technically challenging rocky sections and two Kablar peaks (889 and 885 m)
Views of the West Morava River, Ovčar, Jelica and Debela Gora
additional: The race is certified and awards 1 ITRA point. The time limit is 4 hours for competitors in the Mountaineering Association of Serbia national series and 5 hours for others. The start and finish are at the Nature Centre in Ovčar Banja. The organiser provides clear course marking and safety on the route. The course is certified and counts toward the Mountaineering Association of Serbia series; appropriate equipment is mandatory, and prizes are provided for the top finishers. The race is part of the national mountain-running series and marks the 75th anniversary of the “Kablar” Mountaineering Club.

name: Trka na 10 kilometara 2026
location: Večna vatra, Park prijateljstva, Beograd, Serbia

name: Gledić Ultra trejl 2026
description: Gledić Ultra Trail is a mountain race held in the heart of Serbia, in the Gledić Mountains, offering runners a unique opportunity to experience unspoiled nature across forests, meadows, and mountain ridges. The race features three courses of different lengths and difficulty levels: Lane (12 km), Srna (22 km), and Jelen (ultra, 58 km). All courses are well marked and pass through beautiful natural scenery. This event is more than just a race; it is a gathering of people who share a passion for nature and adventure, with a comprehensive race package and on-course support. The start is scheduled for October 31, 2026, with time limits tailored to the course distances.
course_highlights: Mountain trails through the forests, meadows, and ridges of the Gledić Mountains
Three courses of different lengths: 12 km, 22 km, and 58 km, with significant elevation gain
Beautiful viewpoints and authentic natural landscapes
additional: The race package includes a race-logo T-shirt, medal, chip-timed bib, aid stations, professional photographs, sponsor gifts, and lunch for participants. The courses are marked and secured. The time limit for the longest course is 12 hours, and for the middle-distance course, 6 hours.
